composition: New composition: EXTREME intimate diagonal closeup of king's pale hands rubbing each other over red embroidered sleeve; sorrowful lined face looking down occupies upper right. Apprentice kneeling only partly visible at far edge; ash-filled brazier and empty chancellor chair softly blurred. No live Morden.

New composition: steep overhead view of king pulling thick GREY wool lap blanket up toward himself, hands gripping cloth edge. Apprentice's brown-haired bowed head enters lower corner. Cold is conveyed by hunched frail body; no palace ice, frost or snow. Empty chair partly visible.

New composition: over apprentice's shoulder toward king's closed grief-stricken eyes with parchment loosely held and lowered across grey blanket. Tight medium shot from right. Long silent regret, warm tiny candle reflected in one ring. Empty chair at edge. No palace ice, no Morden.

New composition: camera looking UP past king's white-haired profile toward soaring ordinary stone vaults. His eyes lift with almost relieved expression at news souls were saved. Apprentice in small lower edge silhouette. NO actual aurora indoors, no magical projections, no ice.

New composition: single AGED OIL PAINTING fills left half at oblique angle, craquelure and worn gold frame, painted young dark-haired Isaak with stern kind eyes, no crown. Empty arch corridor recedes right with tall narrow windows, shadow and candle pools. No living people, no extra portraits.

New composition: ground-level MACRO STILL LIFE of ONE empty dusty golden goblet standing on ordinary dry stone floor beside throne. Frail king's lined troubled profile looks down from upper far background, grey blanket over knees. Apprentice boot at far edge, empty chair blurred. No souls or liquids inside cup, no Morden.

New composition: view FROM BEHIND and beside the EMPTY smaller chancellor chair, its dark carved back and unused red cushion dominate foreground right; no objects on chair. Beyond it close crop of king eyes closed in painful realization, apprentice at left edge. No Morden, no ghosts, no puppets.

New composition: apprentice's expressive hand gestures toward far distance central foreground while king LEANS FORWARD toward him, keen curiosity, grey lap blanket slipping slightly. Intimate eye-level TWO PERSON profile composition with contrasting faces at either side. No island or swamp actually inside palace. Empty chair in background.

New composition: LOW heroic three-quarter camera king lifts chin and points UPWARD with one index finger, parchment resting across grey lap blanket. Apprentice dark shoulder in near foreground follows gesture. Candlelit red sleeve and hand prominent central diagonal. No Morden, no tower actually indoors.

New composition: strong SIDE PROFILE of crowned aged king toward tall window dominating left two thirds, fork of lightning OUTSIDE over distant gothic city. His white hair rimlit electric blue, warm amber candle against his cheek. Apprentice faint behind, grey lap blanket. Ordinary dry palace, no indoor lightning.
